rationale.conceptual: The method amounts to applying a few textbook equations (arc length, strain, pre-stretch factor, inverse wavelength–modulus relation) with given constants. There is no novel algorithm, no adaptation of the model, and no domain-specific trick; it is arithmetic at the level of a basic mechanics homework problem.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has three sequential steps: compute AFM wavelength from a small table, compute FESEM wavelength from another small table, then compute the moduli using those results. All steps use only standard Python/NumPy. There are dependencies but no fragile orchestration, multi-tool integration, or heavy I/O. It is slightly more than a single-script job but still trivial.
